messages:
maria: heads up — after the 08:15 deploy the console heatmap charts are much slower on prod. p95 render jumped from ~220ms to ~900ms. :eyes:
cheng: ah. did we change any prefetch/cache behavior in that rollout?
kevin: I rolled the chart fragmentation/async-import patch in canary -> prod this morning. No obvious bundle size bump in CI, but telemetry looked noisier.
samira: deploy-bot: deploy completed by samira to prod/eu-west-1 at 2026-03-20T08:14:22Z :rocket:
maria: repro steps — open dashboard with ~120 series, toggle time range, the initial tiles render slowly and subsequent scrubbing causes reflows. Console shows repeated cache invalidations: 
```
INFO kvcache: miss fragmentKey=viz-frag:chart-xyz:rev=42
INFO kvcache: set fragmentKey=viz-frag:chart-xyz:rev=42 size=13KB
WARN render: fragment-id changed for chart-xyz -> full rehydrate
```
cheng: that log line is new — looks like fragment key includes `rev` now. did Kevin change the fragment fingerprinting?
kevin: yeah I switched fingerprint to include `revision` to avoid stale prefixes after rollout. I thought it was safe because it only changes on model/schema updates. Maybe the revision is being bumped per deploy inadvertently.
lucas: can we check the rollout agent that tags revisions? my hunch: build-time timestamp leaked into the fingerprint so every deploy generates a new key -> prefix cache misses -> full rehydrate -> CPU spike.
kevin: ack. searching repo: `packages/viz/src/prefetch/fingerprint.ts` — patch included `const rev = process.env.BUILD_REV || Date.now()` which is bad.
maria: that would cause eviction on every deploy. That explains p95 jump. Can we hotfix to use semantic model revision (from metadata) instead of build ts?
samira: quick mitigation: revert the canary -> prod rollout or force sticky cache keys via runtime override. Which is faster?
cheng: revert is safest short-term. We should also roll a canary with corrected fingerprint and run perf harness.
kevin: I'll open a rollback PR now and a follow-up that reads revision from manifest.
maria: TY. Also can we add a telemetry gauge for fragment miss rate per deploy so this is obvious next time? current dashboards only show overall render latency, not cache churn.
lucas: +1. adding a `kvcache.fragment_miss_rate` metric with tags (env, deploy_id) would be helpful.
samira: I'll file an infra ticket and prioritize in next sprint if rollback buys us time.
deploy-bot: rollback in progress by kevin to prod/eu-west-1 — initiating canary revert at 2026-03-20T08:26:07Z
maria: after revert I'll run an A/B comparison on the same dashboard to confirm p95 drops.
kevin: PRs: #1984 rollback, #1985 fix fingerprint (reads from viz-manifest.revision). will link when ready.
cheng: great. post the perf harness run link here when you have it so we can add it to the rollout checklist. :thumbsup:
